dedupe_keys.name: pleiadata energy hvac indoor temperature weather and presence data for the pleiades building university of murcia

description: PLEIAData gives detailed operational data from the three blocks (A, B and C) of the Pleiades building at the University of Murcia, a pilot building of the EU PHOENIX project on building efficiency. It was deposited on Zenodo on 16 September 2022 by Antonio Martínez Ibarra, Aurora González-Vidal and Antonio Skarmeta Gómez of the Universidad de Murcia, with a notebook written for a Scientific Data article. It holds electricity consumption aggregated by block in kWh; HVAC data with on/off state, heating or cooling mode, setpoint and device type; indoor temperature per room; weather from IMIDA (temperature, humidity, radiation, dew point, wind direction, precipitation); carbon dioxide and presence for some rooms; and tables linking sensors to rooms and blocks. Coverage: one university building in Murcia, Spain. Access: one 283 MB zip on Zenodo, with files at 10-minute and 60-minute resolution. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: the monitoring period is not stated in the record, and CO2 and presence cover only a few rooms. Simulation uses: HVAC control, load forecasting and digital twin testing for non-residential buildings. Related records: OfficeGraph and the Bolzano monitoring dataset.
